<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0601-12-21" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re de ba ni tshul 'dra mod kyi nges 'byed cha bzhi'i mnyam bzhag la dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba rtogs pa med pa ni mi rigs te | 
				mdo' sde rgyan las de nas de dang gyur pa'i || | byang chub sems dpa' nyam bzhag pa || | yid kyi rtsom ma gtogs pa || | don kun rab du mi mthong po zhes pa dang | chos kyi snga ma'i phel bya'i phyir ||</seg></TEI>
